ISPUTNIK TV · ANDROID TV & FIRE TV

Your films on the big screen.
With the remote, not a browser.

A native app for Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV. It opens to your own home screen — what you were watching, what’s new — with nothing on it but what’s on your server, and a place for everyone in the room.

Download the TV app ↓See what it does ↓
  • No cloud needed
  • No ads
  • No hidden costs
  • No tracking

WHAT IT DOES

Sit back. It knows where you were.

Watch

Made for the remote, from the first screen.

  • Continue watching first, then what’s new
  • Movies and Shows, with sorting and film sets
  • Search at the top
  • Sound and subtitles, your language remembered
  • Skip intro, and the next episode at the credits
  • Plays almost anything — the server converts what the TV can’t

Everyone in the room

One TV, the whole household.

  • Who’s watching? Profiles like Kids, Grandma or Russian
  • Each profile with its own Continue watching, watched marks and My list
  • A PIN that keeps Kids in Kids
  • Your own theme’s colours, always dark

Photos and games

Not only films.

  • Family photos chosen for the TV, by profile
  • Albums and slideshows on the big screen
  • Chess, Checkers, Sputnik Catch and Torpedo Run with the remote

Easy to live with

Set it up once, then forget it’s there.

  • Sign in by scanning a code with your phone
  • Your place shared with the website
  • Offers its own updates
  • A speed test, to see what your Wi-Fi can carry

PRIVATE HERE, SPECIFICALLY

A TV that doesn’t watch you back.

The general promises hold everywhere. These are the ones that matter most for iSputnik TV.

Your password never touches the TV

Sign in by scanning a code and approving on your phone, from your home network. Only the server’s address is typed with the remote.

Nothing of its own

The app holds no accounts and no media. It asks your server for what the website would show you, so every permission stays there.

Profiles can only show less

Profiles are set up by an administrator on the website, never on the TV, so the remote can’t make Kids show more.

Updates without telling on you

The update check goes to GitHub and sends nothing about you or your server.

WORKS WITH

Everything on the sofa.

Movies & TVEvery film and show in your video libraries, with your place shared. Photos & home videoFamily photos and slideshows chosen for the TV. Family gamesBoard and arcade games played with the remote.

WHAT YOU NEED

A TV that runs Android.

A TV or a stick
Android TV, Google TV or Fire TV. Not the newest Fire TV sticks running Vega OS, and not Samsung or LG’s own systems.
iSputnik.home with the video add-on
The TV shows what’s on your server, so video has to be set up there first.
The Downloader app
Free, from the TV’s own store, to install iSputnik TV once while the store versions are on their way.

QUESTIONS

About iSputnik TV.

More in the TV app guide.

Is it in the Play Store or Amazon’s store?

Not yet — it’s on the way. Until then it’s installed once with the free Downloader app, and offers its own updates after that.

Does it work on Samsung or LG TVs?

No — they have their own systems. A Fire TV stick or a Google TV box plugged into them works.

Can the kids switch to another profile?

Not if you set a PIN. Getting into Kids is free; getting out needs the PIN.

What if the TV can’t play a file?

It switches to the server’s converted copy by itself. You may notice a pause of a few seconds.
